message: Lead relay: Combustion v2 performance numbers (SIM, nominal regression, non-equilibrium tank). They will be in combustion.json v2; use them in gnc.json v2 and the 6-DOF. Grain S230, straight port: no designed roll torque. Duty cycle A1: delivered Isp about 188 s (lower than the 205-210 s seed), N2O used 0.902 kg. O/F at 500 N is about 10.4, oxidiser-rich because of the short grain. Minimum thrust-ceiling margin across the duty cycles is 548 N against 500 N. Engine dry mass about +0.11 kg, and the gas path is +30 mm longer, so the engine CG moves slightly. Mechanical will publish the updated mass properties.
